quests.instruction: Touch the round object with hands that tells us what time it is!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: It has a round face, numbers, and hands that slowly move.
quests.explanation: Yes! A clock shows us the time with numbers and moving hands.
quests.funFact: Clock hands have moved the same direction for hundreds of years, called clockwise!

quests.instruction: Touch the chart that shows every day, week, and month of the year!
quests.question: Calendar
quests.hint: It has little boxes, one for each day of the month.
quests.explanation: Yes! A calendar shows the days, weeks, and months of the year.
quests.funFact: A calendar shows twelve months, and each month has its own number of days!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that presses a tiny metal pin through papers to join them!
quests.question: Stapler
quests.hint: It makes a little click sound when you press it down.
quests.explanation: Yes! A stapler presses a tiny metal pin through papers to hold them together.
quests.funFact: The tiny metal pins a stapler uses are called staples!

quests.instruction: Touch the container we fill with water to drink during the school day!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: It is filled with water and often kept in your backpack.
quests.explanation: Yes! A water bottle holds water so we can drink during the school day.
quests.funFact: Drinking enough water can help your brain stay focused during class!

quests.instruction: Touch the colorful liquid we spread on paper with a brush!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: It is wet and colorful until it dries on your paper.
quests.explanation: Yes! Paint is the colorful liquid we brush onto paper for art.
quests.funFact: Paint dries as the water inside it slowly disappears into the air!

quests.instruction: Touch the shiny white board a teacher writes on with markers!
quests.question: Whiteboard
quests.hint: It hangs at the front of the classroom for everyone to see.
quests.explanation: Yes! A whiteboard is the smooth board where a teacher writes each lesson.
quests.funFact: Whiteboard markers wipe away easily, unlike regular permanent markers!

quests.instruction: Touch the sticky roll we use to join paper or fix a torn page!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: It comes on a roll, and one side is very sticky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Tape is the sticky roll we use to join paper together.
quests.funFact: Sticky tape lets people join paper together without any glue mess!

quests.instruction: Touch the small stick that writes in white or color on a board!
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: It writes on a hard, dark board instead of on paper.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chalk is the stick we use to write on a blackboard.
quests.funFact: Chalk is made from a soft rock that can be ground into a stick!

quests.instruction: Find the chart we check to see what today's date is!
quests.question: Calendar
quests.hint: You check it to find out today's date or a special day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We check a calendar to find today's date.
quests.funFact: Some classroom calendars let students move a marker to show today's date!

quests.instruction: Find the stick that leaves a soft, powdery mark on a blackboard!
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: It feels a little dusty and can leave marks on your fingers.
quests.explanation: That's right! Chalk leaves a soft mark that a cloth can wipe away.
quests.funFact: Outdoor chalk lets children draw colorful pictures right on the sidewalk!

quests.instruction: Find the bottle we sip from when we feel thirsty at school!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: You take small sips from it when you feel thirsty.
quests.explanation: That's right! We sip from a water bottle to stay refreshed at school.
quests.funFact: Many water bottles have a special cap so they never spill in a backpack!

quests.instruction: Find the board at the front of class that markers wipe clean off of!
quests.question: Whiteboard
quests.hint: Markers write on it easily, and a wipe cleans it right off.
quests.explanation: That's right! A whiteboard lets a teacher write and then wipe it clean.
quests.funFact: Some whiteboards are magnetic, so little magnets can stick to them too!

quests.instruction: Find the tool we press down to snap two papers firmly together!
quests.question: Stapler
quests.hint: It joins papers together with a tiny, bent piece of metal.
quests.explanation: That's right! We press a stapler down to join pages neatly.
quests.funFact: A stapler can join many sheets of paper together in just one press!

quests.instruction: Find the object we check to see if it's almost time for recess!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: You check it to see how much longer until your next class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We check a clock to see how much time is left.
quests.funFact: Some classroom clocks have a big hand for minutes and a small hand for hours!

quests.instruction: Find the clear, sticky strip that holds two things together!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: You peel a strip off and press it down to make things stick.
quests.explanation: That's right! We peel off a strip of tape to fix or stick things.
quests.funFact: Some tape is clear, so you can barely see it once it's stuck down!

quests.instruction: Find the wet, colorful item that fills a picture with color!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: You need a brush to spread it smoothly across your page.
quests.explanation: That's right! We dip a brush in paint to color a picture.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people made paint from crushed rocks, plants, and even berries!

quests.instruction: Touch the pen with bright, bold ink that we use for coloring!
quests.question: Marker
quests.hint: Its ink is thick and bold, much darker than a pencil's line.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use a marker for bright writing and drawing.
quests.funFact: Markers can dry out if you forget to put the cap back on!

quests.instruction: Point to the soft, waxy stick children use most for coloring!
quests.question: Crayon
quests.hint: You press it on paper to fill a picture with color, not words.
quests.explanation: Correct! A crayon colors a picture, while a pencil is better for writing words.
quests.funFact: Crayons are made from wax, which is why they melt in hot sunshine!

quests.instruction: Touch the chart with little boxes for each day of the month!
quests.question: Calendar
quests.hint: It helps you count down the days until something exciting happens.
quests.explanation: Well done! A calendar helps our class keep track of special days.
quests.funFact: A calendar shows twelve months, and each month has its own number of days!

quests.instruction: Touch the item a teacher uses to write big words on a board!
quests.question: Chalk
quests.hint: A wet or dry cloth can wipe its marks away easily.
quests.explanation: Well done! Chalk helps a teacher write a lesson for the whole class to see.
quests.funFact: Chalk is made from a soft rock that can be ground into a stick!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that makes a little click when it joins your papers!
quests.question: Stapler
quests.hint: You press down on it firmly, right on top of your papers.
quests.explanation: Well done! A stapler keeps a whole stack of papers from getting mixed up.
quests.funFact: The tiny metal pins a stapler uses are called staples!

quests.instruction: Touch the smooth board where today's lesson is written for everyone to see!
quests.question: Whiteboard
quests.hint: It is smooth, shiny, and usually white in color.
quests.explanation: Well done! A whiteboard helps the whole class see the lesson clearly.
quests.funFact: Whiteboard markers wipe away easily, unlike regular permanent markers!

quests.instruction: Touch the container that keeps us feeling cool and refreshed in class!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: It has a lid or cap that opens and closes tightly.
quests.explanation: Well done! A water bottle helps students stay cool and ready to learn.
quests.funFact: Drinking enough water can help your brain stay focused during class!

quests.instruction: Touch the object with numbers around its edge and hands that move!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: Its hands move all day, even when nobody is watching.
quests.explanation: Well done! A clock helps our whole class know when it's time to go.
quests.funFact: Clock hands have moved the same direction for hundreds of years, called clockwise!

quests.instruction: Point to the pouch that keeps your desk neat and tidy!
quests.question: Pencil Case
quests.hint: It is small enough to fit right inside your backpack.
quests.explanation: Correct! A pencil case travels inside your backpack with all your tools.
quests.funFact: A tidy pencil case can help you find your pencil in just one second!

quests.instruction: Point to the thing we borrow from a library to read at home!
quests.question: Book
quests.hint: You open it and turn each page to find out what happens next.
quests.explanation: Correct! A book is the perfect place to find your favorite story.
quests.funFact: Some books have thousands of pages, while others have only a few!

quests.instruction: Touch the thin, flat sheet that we write and draw on every day!
quests.question: Paper
quests.hint: A pencil, crayon, or marker leaves its mark right on this.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use paper for writing letters and drawing pictures.
quests.funFact: Paper was first made from tree bark, plants, and old cloth long ago!

quests.instruction: Touch the item that needs a paintbrush before it goes onto paper!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: It comes in small pots or tubes of every color.
quests.explanation: Well done! Paint fills a picture with bright, wet color.
quests.funFact: Paint dries as the water inside it slowly disappears into the air!

quests.instruction: Touch the roll we peel and stick to hold our art in place!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: It can fix a torn page or hold up a poster.
quests.explanation: Well done! Tape can mend a torn page or hold a poster on the wall.
quests.funFact: Sticky tape lets people join paper together without any glue mess!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for a person who comes to school to learn!
quests.question: Student
quests.hint: This word describes you every single day that you go to school.
quests.explanation: That's right! A student sits in class, listens, and practices new skills.
quests.funFact: Students all around the world go to school to learn new things every day!
